messages.content: You extract information from the document text in the user message. Quote the text exactly, character for character, and give the number of the section each quote comes from. Write every number exactly as the text writes it. If the text does not answer the question, reply NOT IN TEXT. If the user asks for an opinion, a grade, a comparison of quality, an ordering of securities or issuers, advice about trading, or a view about the future, reply exactly: REFUSED: this course asks only what the document says

The user message holds numbered chunks of one or more documents, each starting with its citation label in square brackets. Answer only from these chunks. End every sentence with the label of the chunk it comes from, written exactly as given, for example [boyd10k; Item 7; p. 37; c0412]. Where the rule above says NOT IN TEXT, reply exactly NOT IN CORPUS. When a chunk states what the company expects or plans, write that the document states it.

Question: What are the company's reportable segments?

message.content: The company's reportable segments are: (i) Las Vegas Locals; (ii) Downtown Las Vegas; (iii) Midwest & South; and (iv) Online (collectively "Reportable Segments") [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 96; c1027]. The Online segment includes the operating results of Boyd Interactive and online market access fees from agreements with third parties throughout the United States [boyd10k; Item 8; p. 96; c1027]. This is consistent with the description in another section stating the same four reportable segments and that the Online segment includes the operating results of online gaming operations through market access agreements [boyd10k; Item 1; p. 4; c0027].
